nodes.description: Germline BRAF variants act at the RAF tier. They are biochemically heterogeneous: some raise B-Raf kinase activity outright, while others are kinase-impaired and yet still phosphorylate the downstream effectors MEK and ERK. Both classes therefore raise pathway output, which is why an impaired in-vitro kinase measurement does not exclude a variant as causal.

evidence.snippet: The majority of cases (18 out of 23) are caused by mutations in BRAF, a gene frequently mutated in cancer. Of the 11 mutations identified, two result in amino acid substitutions that occur in tumors, but most are unique and suggest previously unknown mechanisms of B-Raf activation.

nodes.description: MAP2K1 and MAP2K2 encode MEK1 and MEK2, the immediate downstream effectors of B-Raf. Germline CFC variants in either gene increase MEK kinase activity, measured as increased phosphorylation of ERK, and together account for about a quarter of cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome.

nodes.description: Germline KRAS missense variants act at the most upstream step of the cascade, dysregulating RAS-RAF-ERK signal transduction before the RAF tier. This is the molecular entry point for the CFC2 subtype and the step shared with the RASopathies that cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome phenotypically overlaps.
